response.justification: While Bogdan exceeds the 15-year experience requirement with strong full-stack engineering credentials, he lacks the specialized AI expertise and strategic vision required for this director-level AI strategy role. His AI experience is very recent (1.3 years), he lacks the preferred Master's or PhD in AI-related fields, and his career has focused on software craftsmanship and infrastructure rather than strategic AI innovation or advising customers on cutting-edge AI adoption. The position requires demonstrated AI platform/product expertise and C-level advisory capabilities, which are not evident in his background.
strengths: Exceeds 15-year experience requirement with 20+ years of diverse software engineering across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Demonstrated entrepreneurial experience founding GISCollective and strong open-source contributions reflecting technical thought leadership in developer communities
Recent exposure to AI infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq showing emerging engagement with modern AI/agent technologies
concerns: AI expertise is very recent (1.3 years) with no demonstrated products or platforms built with significant AI specialization prior to current role
Career trajectory has prioritized code quality and full-stack development over strategic AI innovation or business-level customer advisory
Missing preferred qualification of Master's or PhD in AI-related field, with no evidence of formal machine learning or deep AI/ML system expertise
